alt: Demir checks the twelve-reading synthetic stream before building windows across its split.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose the LAST reference into a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit lesson scene. References 1 through 1 are canonical identity authorities in this order: ensign-demir. Reference 2 is the room authority; reference 3 is the original edit target for story action, lighting and palette only. Preserve exact recognizable canonical facial structure, eye spacing, nose, jaw, mouth, complexion, age and signature equipment. Exactly 1 humans, the named cast only. Preserve balanced adult proportions and candid expressions. Exactly two complete arms per person, each from its own shoulder through one elbow and neutral wrist to one plausible hand. Ordinary thumb sides, fingers and natural object contact; no extra arm or bent prop. No camera-facing portraits. Faces visible naturally three-quarter with eyes directed toward work or each other. Use available empty wall or upper space for a large upright primary lesson display that is physically plausible and faces its operators. All text and lines follow the display plane, crisp and generously sized with comfortable margins. Keep essential content fully visible. Never put the sole lesson evidence upside down on paper or flat table, or on a tiny tabletop screen beneath a blank wall. Secondary paper can face its owner, but essential content is repeated upright. Remove meaningless decorative technical labels. No generic success verdicts, invented numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks or signatures. Ensign Demir: young adult man, light warm skin with freckles, thick dark swept hair, short stubble, charcoal jumpsuit and green ear device.
Specific action and staging: Keep Demir seated at the bridge keyboard in focused three-quarter view, both hands typing naturally and eyes on the screen. Keep the same upright large main screen, warm brass and green light. Correct the misleading unqualified mission window value to the actual synthetic exercise setup.
Exact visible display content: Title "Synthetic window check". Large single row "Readings: 0 through 11". Parameter blocks "Window: 4", "Split at: 8", "Stride: 1". Checklist "Split the recording first", "Keep windows within each side", "Use the last reading label". Footer "Checks pending". Do not show solved counts, classification labels or 80-reading mission setting.
